verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official first-party routing library for SolidJS. The first-party GitHub material lists state, Context, Stores, Resources, SSR, Suspense and Vite integration, but never routing. The only related item is a community remark about 'SolidStart routing' being slow. It does not establish SolidStart as a first-party Solid project, does not document a routing library, and says nothing about integration with the framework.
